full_AB.text: same here . I have't brought any new clothes for three months .

full_AB.text: inflation is more than just the rising prices , I guess . But the central bank is warning about the risk of inflation .

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: has the government taken some measures to curb it ?

full_AB.speaker: A
full_AB.text: yes . The government has banned price hikes in some key industries like energy .

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: but I'm afraid the price hikes will spill over from food into other areas of the economy .

full_AB.speaker: A
full_AB.text: you said it . I think we should tighten our budget and cut our spending .

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: how ?

full_AB.speaker: A
full_AB.text: for a start , we can take the public transport to work . You know , running a car is a big expense .

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: sounds a good idea .
